milestone: M7 — GS2-07.1 event envelope and cursor

findings.summary: Verification accepted structurally tampered envelopes and silently normalized schema, order, and duplicate changes.
evidence: Verification: exact-head probes against 8067301 showed verify returning Ok after schema mutation, delivery reversal, and duplicate append; durable review comment 5536232071 records the changes-required verdict.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 compares schema and exact canonical delivery structure before seal acceptance; unit negative cases and direct probes reject all three mutations.

findings.summary: Subject, causation, and correlation relationships were not enforced as one coherent event chain.
evidence: Verification: direct 8067301 probes accepted cross-subject input, dangling causation event-999, and a changed correlation within one chain.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 enforces one subject, prior-event causation, and stable correlation; exact-head adversarial probes return typed refusals.

findings.summary: Distinct deliveries could reuse one receipt identity without a conflict.
evidence: Verification: candidate 8067301 grouped delivery, event, and cursor conflicts but accepted a second delivery carrying the first receipt ID.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 rejects conflicting receipt reuse and the exact-head reuse probe returns ReceiptMismatch.

findings.summary: Unframed cursor concatenation aliased delimiter-bearing delivery and event identities.
evidence: Verification: candidate 8067301 produced the same public cursor for delivery/event pairs a:b+c and a+b:c.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 length-frames every cursor component; the delimiter-bearing identities now produce distinct cursors.

findings.summary: The nominally independent controls shared the generated executor and did not independently establish the adversarial contract.
evidence: Verification: the initial Q3 path used the generated control switch, baseline, and implementation for both retained inventories.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 has separate generated and independently authored executors, distinct retained 22-case inventories, and Q3 passed all controls.

findings.summary: The initial SDD handoff was not reproducible from a clean exact checkout and reused one focused artifact for unrelated build and suite claims.
evidence: Verification: the initial branch omitted required SDD provider files and did not retain distinct build, Q3, focused, unit, and architecture evidence artifacts.
resolution_evidence: Verification: candidate b058041 tracks the complete provider package and distinct evidence files; clean detached verify→ship fixed points passed with 208 unit and 492 architecture tests.
